comments.author: Paul Fox
comments.html:
I grabbed a copy of the sources and they broke apart dtrace.c into smaller files, which makes observing changes and diffing with Illumos, tricky.

They are lacking ctf.

Would be interesting to push their dtrace hard, and see what breaks, e.g. the torture test from my dtrace implementation would be insightful.

comments.author: ahl
comments.html: BSD went down the road of splitting up dtrace.c... and then they glued it back together once they realized that it effectively created an unintentional fork. As for OEL, there's nothing going on upstream (Oracle Solaris).
